newsitem.title: USA: Stewart files for up to $300 mln in debt.
newsitem.headline: Stewart files for up to $300 mln in debt.

text.p: Stewart Enterprises Inc said Friday it filed a registration statement with the Securities and Exchange Commission to sell up to $300 million in debt securities.

The net proceeds from the sale will be used for general corporate purposes, which may include the repayment of outstanding debts, acquisitions, capital expenditures and working capital, the filing said.
There were no underwriters named in the filing.
Stewart is a provider of products and services in the death care industry. The company is headquartered in Metairie, Louisiana.
